SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_pay, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_delivery, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_receive, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunding FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.status = #{status}
SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND s.seller_id = #{sellerId}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * sk.cost_price), 0) FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN sku sk ON oi.sku_id = sk.id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.status = 4 AND o.created_at >= #{startTime}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(od.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(od.pay_amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.pay_amount, o.created_at FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.status = 4 AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} ) od GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(od.created_at, '${dateFormat}') AS `label`, SUM(od.pay_amount) AS salesAmount, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oq.totalQuantity), 0) AS salesVolume FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.created_at, o.pay_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN spu s ON oi.spu_id = s.id WHERE s.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.status = 4 AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} ) od LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id ) oq ON od.id = oq.order_id GROUP BY `label` ORDER BY `label`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '${dateFormat}') AS `label`, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS salesAmount, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oq.totalQuantity), 0) AS salesVolume FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id ) oq ON o.id = oq.order_id WHERE o.status = 4 AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY `label` ORDER BY `label`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 4 AND created_at >= #{startTime}
